description: Additional conditional single-customer browser/SCIM case, not a replacement for the primary multi-tenant B2B profile or the 18 frozen synthetic acceptance cases.

usagePlanning.scopeDescription: Synthetic single-customer application instance; volumes and hosting costs are not established.

limitations: Current claims are UNREVIEWED. This fixture is not an evaluated result, a trusted shortlist or proof of configured security.
SCIM remains REQUIRED and means inbound realm Users support only; outbound SaaS provisioning, group/org synchronization and local-session enforcement are not proven.
Single application-organization mapping is an explicit design assumption. Native Organizations, shared multi-tenant membership and upstream vendor pairings are not selected.

Other primary B2B requirements have not been satisfied by this narrower profile. Multi-client, enterprise federation, strong controls, auditability and required residency must still be evaluated when requested.
No LLM, live Keycloak deployment or vendor integration was used. Self-hosting responsibilities, costs, application authorization and lifecycle tests remain explicit follow-ups.
